verdict.summary: The change correctly limits the new hand-off comment to self-attested orchestrator-class request-changes outcomes where the live review-state mutation actually returned `applied`. Worker-lane outcomes remain silent, and converged or refused human-hold outcomes do not receive misleading relabel instructions. The comment gives the load-bearing push-before-relabel ordering and exact `review:changes` to `review:needs` transition. Tests exercise the production call site, emitted body, lane discriminator, state-result gate, direction/order/round content, and the real label primitive's return vocabulary with independent literals. No trust check is weakened and no untrusted text is introduced into an executable context.
